lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 4th vertical line from the anterior, splitting approximately one-third of the way down from the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several abbreviated line segments are visible between the 5th and 7th primary vertical lines, terminating mid-torso without reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 4 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch, localized above the junction of the hind limb and torso.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white horizontal bands are visible on the lower shins of both the front and hind legs, just above the hooves, and a large white patch is visible on the underside of the tail/rump area.
